description_expanded: This beautiful, new Alys Beach home perfectly embodies the New Urbanism design of Alys Beach with pedestrian paths on all four sides of the home. The front of the home is off-set from North Charles Street giving extra privacy to all occupants. The first floor offers two en-suite bedrooms on opposite ends of the home, a spacious great room with vaulted ceilings and an open-plan kitchen with large, center island. A spacious courtyard with a private pool, covered loggia with ample outdoor seating and a built-in grill complete this level. The second floor features two more bedrooms with private baths as well as a roof-top deck with bistro tables and chairs and a large swing perfect for relaxation. The home is particularly inviting to groups and families with maximum separation of all four bedrooms with the two second floor bedrooms accessible from separate staircases. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
